title: How to follow up with your Free IGNYT Sample leads
titleHtml: How to follow up with your Free IGNYT Sample leads
sub: Use these scripts the same day a sample request comes in.

video.title: Funnel scripts training video
video.caption: Watch this before you start calling.

steps.title: Call them
steps.lead: They probably won't pick up, so leave this voicemail:
script: I saw you just requested a free 3 day sample of IGNYT, and I'm the one getting it in the mail to you.
I only need one thing before it goes out, and that's to make sure I have the right address. I'm going to text you now, so just reply to that and I'll get it sent.

If you don't see my text, check your Unknown Senders or Spam folder. On an iPhone, look for the filter or menu icon in the top right corner of your Messages app, its usually three little lines. On an Android, look for the three-dot menu. You should be able to find any filtered messages there which is where my text to you might be.
Okay, that's all for now! Talk soon.

steps.title: Text them
steps.lead: As soon as you hang up, send this:
script: Hey [Name], it's [Your Name]! 👋 Just left you a quick voicemail. You requested a free 3 day sample of IGNYT and I want to get it in the mail to you today.
Can you confirm this is where I'm sending it? [Address]
Reply YES and it goes out. It's 3 single serve sticks, one a day in 8oz of water, and it comes out like a light citrus drink.

steps.title: Email them too
steps.lead: Send this the same day. Plenty of people read email before they answer an unknown number:
script: Subject: Confirming where to send your IGNYT sample
You requested a free 3 day sample of IGNYT and I'm getting it packed up for you. Before it goes out, can you confirm this address is right? [Address]
Just reply to this email and I'll drop it in the mail. Samples are limited, so the sooner you confirm the sooner yours ships.

steps.title: Follow up in 24 hrs
steps.lead: If they don't confirm within 24 hours, text again:
script: [Name]! Just following up on my text above! 👆 I still have your IGNYT sample set aside. Send me a quick yes on the address and I'll get it out to you today.

tip: Tip: Personalize [Name] and [Your Name], and paste their real address into [Address] before you send. Some people will have already texted you the word SAMPLE from the confirmation page, so check your messages first. If they have, you only need to confirm the address and ship it.
